CustomField.description: Outcome-based acceptance margin for the distillation second pass. The distiller is sampled (no temperature control), so a distilled pass replaces the deterministic first pass only when it reaches draftable strength (Retrieval_Distill_Trigger_Score__c) AND beats the first pass topScore by MORE than this margin. Lower = accept distilled recovery more readily (higher recall, more variance); higher = only accept a decisive improvement. Only used when Retrieval_Query_Distill_Enabled__c is true. Apex fallback when unset: 0.10.
CustomField.label: Retrieval Distill Accept Margin
